saints.name: St. Lawrence
saints.title: Deacon and Martyr
saints.shortBlurb: A deacon of Rome who, ordered to hand over the Church’s treasures, gathered the poor and said, “These are the treasures of the Church”…
biography: Lawrence was one of the seven deacons of Rome under Pope St. Sixtus II, charged with the care of the Church’s goods and the poor. In the persecution of Valerian in 258, commanded by the prefect to surrender the Church’s wealth, he distributed it to the needy and presented the poor of the city as its true treasure.

For this he was put to death, and ancient tradition holds that he was roasted on a gridiron. His courage and cheerfulness in death made him one of the most honored martyrs of Rome, and his name too stands in the Canon of the Mass.
saints.knownFor: “The treasures of the Church are the poor”; martyrdom on the gridiron.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 10 August
